title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Standard error response envelope returned by both Cloudflare Worker gateway and FastAPI backend.

code.description: Closed error code enum representing system failure or policy violation.

message.description: Technical or actionable description of the error.

retry_after_s.description: Suggested client backoff delay in seconds for transient or rate-limited errors.

request_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID or salted request hash) matching logs for tracing.
